name: Forehand loop against topspin
summary: Topspin on a topspin ball: a more forward swing that closes over the ball.
whenToUse: Against a block or a drive to your forehand when you have time to swing. It keeps the pressure on.

keyPoints.stance: Wide, right foot back (left foot if left-handed), knees bent.
keyPoints.bodyAction: Hips and shoulders turn back, then the legs push and the body turns into the ball.
keyPoints.strokeLength: Medium: from about table height to head height, more forward than up.
keyPoints.timing: At the top of the bounce or just before it for a faster ball.
keyPoints.tablePosition: About a metre from the end line.
keyPoints.freeArm: Balances the turn; pulls in as you rotate.
keyPoints.batArm: Relaxed, elbow a little bent. Bat closed, about 45 degrees forward.
keyPoints.recovery: Reset fast; against a block the ball comes back quickly.
keyPoints.anticipation: A block has little spin of its own: aim lower and swing forward.

cues: Close the bat over the ball

learningPath.task: Compare it with the loop against backspin: see how much more forward the swing is.
learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.

learningPath.task: Follow-along: turn, swing forward, finish at head height.
learningPath.passCheck: 3 sets of 10, then yes to all self-checks.
selfChecks: Did the swing go forward more than up?
Did your weight move to the front foot?

learningPath.task: Loop light topspin balls to one spot.
Loop against a steady block until 10 in a row.
Open against backspin, then loop the block that comes back.
Test: loops against a block in a row.

gamePatterns.situation: You opened with a loop and they block it back.
gamePatterns.how: Loop again with a little more speed to the other corner or the elbow.

gamePatterns.situation: A slow, high topspin from a defender.
gamePatterns.how: Step in and loop through it: forward and fast, aim deep.

fixes: Close the bat over the ball

troubleshooting.symptom: The ball goes into the net
causes: Too closed against a slow ball
fixes: Open a little against slow balls
Meet it at the top of the bounce

troubleshooting.symptom: I can't do two in a row
causes: No recovery after the first loop
fixes: Reset to ready after each loop

penholdNotes: Same body action; penholders often close the face with a little more wrist.
